purpose: Exact offline maturity authority for access to adult-scoped folders in the shared local media library. This is a media-access decision only; it does not approve a body, anatomy, activation, relationship, memory, or publication.
rules: An exact explicit non-adult entry always denies every adult-scoped path and category.
An unknown or unresolved identity is denied adult-scoped paths by default.
An exact explicit adult entry may open adult-scoped library media, subject to the same owner-selection, session-binding, privacy, and no-publication controls as every other file.
Maturity is never inferred from a name, actor, body, anatomy, occupation, or media choice.
Explicit adult-folder media is identified by the curated prefixes and exact paths above, not by broad title keywords that would misclassify educational or cultural material.

Outside the separate explicit-adult-folder boundary, existing index rating/category metadata is evaluated before Robert's durable exact mature-mainstream classification; verified local title metadata is the next permitted source when such a catalog exists.
Mainstream mature media remains discoverable to a non-adult but requires a fresh adult co-viewing decision for playback; a co-viewing decision never becomes a permanent unlock.
A library branch named for Robert or another person is resident library media and is not private merely because of that name.
A direct path request is evaluated by the same gate as a search result and cannot bypass it.
